The Jedi Archives still identify this… ''slum'' as a trading post. But there hasn't been any ''legitimate'' business here in decades. Now, it's a pleasure pit for any murderer, pirate, spice fiend, and gambler with ties to Black Sun.|Aayla Secura|}} '''Trigalis''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]]. Long before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] post of [[New Coronet]] was founded on Trigalis, but over [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[City/Legends|city]] degenerated into a busy center of various illegal activities. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19.48 BBY]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] was assigned a mission to Trigalis. A [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later, the planet was also [[Mission to Trigalis|visited]] by [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who was investigating rumors of the survival of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] believed to have been [[Duel in the Coruscant Underlevels|previously killed]]. Evading groups of local thugs attempting to rob him, Kenobi rendezvoused with Secura, who led him to the [[Xist's fortress|fortress]] of [[Xist]], a local [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] enforcer with ties to the Confederacy. After nightfall, Kenobi attacked the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], causing several explosions and defeating many of the compound's guards. Finally, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] engaged Xist himself in a vicious duel, demanding he surrender information on Ventress's whereabouts. Following his defeat, Xist intentionally provided Kenobi with a misleading tip, claiming that the Confederacy had sent a top agent to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] one of Xist's rivals at the world of [[Maramere]]. The following [[Standard day/Legends|day]], Kenobi left Trigalis in [[Aayla Secura's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Secura's starfighter]] in order to recruit [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] for assistance in [[Mission to Maramere|preventing]] the planned [[Death/Legends|assassination]]. ==Description== {{Quote|I thought you were going to slip into town quietly.''"
"''It couldn't be helped, ''Master Secura''. The swamps were more ''dangerous'' than I anticipated.|Aayla Secura and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} Trigalis was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Trigalis system/Legends|Trigalis system]] of the [[Juris sector/Legends|Juris sector]], a part of the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Trigalis [[Star system/Legends|system]] lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Five Veils Route]], which connected it to the [[Ninzam system/Legends|Ninzam]] and [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet systems]]. The surface of Trigalis, which appeared [[Color/Legends|blue]] and green from [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], was covered by [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] that were overgrown with [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and were home to a [[Species/Legends|species]] of yellow flying [[Bird/Legends|bird]], as well as dark-blue [[Limb/Legends|winged]] [[Insect/Legends|insects]]. ==History== ===Republic shadowport=== {{Quote|I have been ordered to ''Trigalis'', Master Tholme. You would be going to Saleucami ''alone''.|Aayla Secura|[[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]]}} [[File:AaylaSecura-TSWB.png|thumb|left|175px|Aayla Secura was assigned on a mission to Trigalis.]] The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Trigalis system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000]] and [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]]. At some point long before the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[New Coronet]] was established on Trigalis as a [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] post. Over [[Time/Legends|time]], the city devolved into a haven for individuals indulging in criminal activities, most of whom were connected to the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] syndicate, and the planet Trigalis became a famous [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]]. During the Clone Wars, Trigalis fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic's [[Fifteenth Army|Fifteenth Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the planet's vicinity.''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' Around the date [[19 BBY/Legends|19.48 BBY]],''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]] to "[[19 BBY/Legends|19.48 BBY]] (2 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], 6 [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]])." while traveling through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] after a [[Mission to Anzat|mission]] to the world of [[Anzat/Legends|Anzat]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]{{CSWECite|III|134|Secura, Aayla}} [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] told her fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tholme/Legends|Tholme]] that she had been ordered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to travel to Trigalis on a mission. ===Kenobi's mission=== ====Hunting for leads==== {{Quote|That's six swoops he's trashed! Whatever he's carryin' can't be worth ''that'' much!''"
"''He's got a ''laser sword''. I seen it. And that'll buy us a whole ''fleet'' of swoops!|Two Trigalis thugs, while pursuing Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} A [[Standard month/Legends|month]] later,''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]] to "2 [[Standard year/Legends|years]], 7 [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]," which is one month later than the date provided for the events of [[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]]. [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] engaged in a personal mission to confirm his suspicions that [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], a Confederacy [[Commander/Legends|commander]] believed to have been [[Duel in the Coruscant Underlevels|killed]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], had, in fact, survived. To that end, Kenobi [[Mission to Trigalis|visited]] Trigalis, where he had arranged to meet with Secura in New Coronet, having been previously instructed by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]]''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] not to allow his own mission to interfere with that of Secura. [[File:Swoopobiwana.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Obi-Wan Kenobi rides a swoop to evade pursuing thugs in the Trigalis swamps.]] While Kenobi was still away from the city, a [[Unidentified swooper|green-skinned swooper]] noticed the Jedi using [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]]. The [[Swooper/Legends|swooper]], together with seven other [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]]-mounted thugs who were all intent on [[Thief/Legends|confiscating]] Kenobi's possessions, proceeded to pursue him through a stretch of Trigalis's swamps, peppering their quarry with [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]]. Kenobi, who was wearing a mask and was also riding a swoop, crippled six of the pursuers' [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]], including one that he destroyed with a thrown explosive. Heading for New Coronet, Kenobi disposed of another pursuer when the latter crashed his swoop in a bridge on the settlement's outskirts. Arriving in the city, Kenobi [[Cho mai/Legends|dismembered]] his lone remaining pursuer, causing him to crash as well. Immediately thereafter, a group of Black Sun thugs surrounded Kenobi and demanded he surrender his [[Currency/Legends|money]] and [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Refusing, Kenobi proceeded to throw one of the thugs through the [[Window/Legends|window]] of a nearby [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Inside, he met with Secura. Removing his mask, Kenobi let Secura introduce him to New Coronet while escorting him through the city's streets toward the [[Xist's fortress|personal fortress]] of [[Xist]], the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]]{{CSWECite|III|342-343|Xist}} local Black Sun authority who was providing weapons and intelligence to the Confederacy. ====Tips and lies==== {{Quote|This doesn't make any sense… An army does not sneak into New Coronet without notice…''"
"''Not an army, Lord Xist. Just a general in the Republic Army, seeking ''information'' from New Coronet's most ''reliable'' resource.''"
"''A ''Jedi'' seeking only ''death'', I think.|Xist and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} [[File:XistVibroWhip.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Obi-Wan Kenobi dueled Xist on Trigalis in order to extract information from him.]] Kenobi refused any further assistance from Secura and waited until nightfall before entering the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]]. Once inside, the Jedi prevented alarms from triggering early. He then defeated many of Xist's guards—leading Xist to believe at first that an entire [[Army/Legends|army]] had invaded the compound—and in the process caused several explosions that were noticed by the city's residents. Finally, Kenobi confronted Xist and requested the enforcer give information to him. In response, the Falleen drew his [[Vibrowhip/Legends|vibrowhip]], leading the two to engage in a vicious duel. During the fight, Kenobi continued to demand that Xist reveal the location of Ventress. When he was finally defeated, the Black Sun leader agreed to reveal to the Jedi what little he knew about Ventress's survival. Xist then invited Kenobi to another room of the fortress and told the Jedi that he could not confirm the veracity of rumors about Ventress's survival. The Falleen did, however, know that the Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|leader]], [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], had sent one of his best agents to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Xist's rival, the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]]{{CSWECite|II|226|Korr, Drama}} [[Drama Korr]]. Xist also told Kenobi that the hit on Korr would occur when the merchant arrived at the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]][[Obsession 2|''Obsession'' 2]] world of [[Maramere]] in a few [[Standard day/Legends|days']] time. In truth, the enforcer had intentionally provided misleading information to Kenobi, as the agent assigned to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Korr was the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Durge/Legends|Durge]], not Ventress, as Kenobi assumed. The following day, Kenobi contacted the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. He was then seen off at a landing platform by Secura, who had loaned Kenobi [[Aayla Secura's Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|her starfighter]] so that he could travel to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in order to recruit Anakin Skywalker's assistance in [[Mission to Maramere|preventing]] the assassination of Korr. ===Under the Empire=== Trigalis was located just outside space controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military forces]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanded]] by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Octavian Grant]] passed through the Trigalis system as they [[Five Veils Campaign|pursued]] [[Marath Vooro]], the former [[Customs Vizier]] of the disestablished [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], from the planet [[Farstine]] down the Five Veils Route. [[File:Celot.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Celot Ratua Dil (standing), who was arrested on Trigalis]] Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]],''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' the [[Zelosian]] [[Thief/Legends|thief]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Celot Ratua Dil]] visited a [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] pub on Trigalis to enjoy a mug of [[Alcohol/Legends|ferment]]. During his stay there, the Zelosian started haggling over previously stolen [[meelweekian silk]] with a member of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang who was also present in the bar. Unfortunately for Ratua Dil, he was promptly arrested by local authorities, who assumed he was also a pirate. Since the [[Judge/Legends|judges]] presiding over the Zelosian's case were convinced he was guilty of at least some criminal transgressions, if not the original accusation of piracy, he was sentenced to [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] prison planet [[Despayre]].[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] ==Inhabitants== {{Quote|More thieves?''"
"''Local ''tax'' collectors. Your credits and your weapon. We want 'em.''"
"''So did he.''"
"Black Sun assassins'' is a whole lot more dangerous than a little swamp rat, I think.''"
"''Let's find out.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and a Black Sun enforcer|}} The population of the Trigalis system around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] was between 10 million to 100 million. Representatives of several [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species were present in the city of New Coronet on Trigalis. The species' mix included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], a number of whom were employed as guards in the fortress of Black Sun authority Xist. Several inhabitants of Trigalis spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. Individuals accused of breaking the law on Trigalis could offer to undergo a [[truth-scan]] in order to determine their innocence, on the condition that they would reimburse the expenses involved in the procedure. If the defendant lacked the means to pay for a truth-scan, the judges arbitrating the case could choose to fund the procedure using tax income. ==Locations== {{Quote|[…] the whole town is run from here, by a Black Sun killer named ''Xist''.|Aayla Secura|}} [[File:Obsession_1_06.jpg|thumb|left|170px|New Coronet, the primary port city of Trigalis]] The primary port city of Trigalis,{{CSWECite|III|263|Trigalis}} New Coronet was a settlement consisting of red-hued, run-down buildings located in an elevated area overlooking a swamp. There were at least two wooden pedestrian bridges and a pier on the city's edge. Originally founded as a trading post, New Coronet had already become a center of illicit activities [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before the Clone Wars erupted, catering to the needs of murderers, pirates, [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Drug dealer|dealers]], and [[Gambling/Legends|gamblers]], most of whom had ties to the Black Sun organization. Nevertheless, many travel guides continued to designate the city as a trading post. During the Clone Wars, New Coronet was controlled by the Black Sun leader Xist from a heavily guarded stone fortress located inside the city. The compound featured a central tower; a room that had one wall lined with several different bladed weapons, firearms, and various trophy [[Bone/Legends|skulls]]; and a room with a balcony and a large stone table. In the last of these rooms, a pair of [[wheel]]ed [[Service droid/Legends|servant droids]] was present and catered to Xist and Obi-Wan Kenobi during their conversation. ==Behind the scenes== Trigalis first appeared in the [[Obsession 1|first issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]]. The comic was published in [[2004]], and was written by [[W. Haden Blackman|Haden Blackman]] and penciled by [[Brian Ching]]. The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Trigalis system, and therefore the planet Trigalis, in grid square P-17. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Trigalis}} *[[Republic 72|''Republic'' 72]] {{Mo}} *[[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]] {{1st}} *[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']] {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=Aayla Secura's Jedi Starfighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TACaaylafighter.asp}} *''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' *''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' *''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' *[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] *''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Collector's Guide & Galaxy Chart]]'' *[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] *[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Trigalis |es=Trigalis/Leyendas |fi=Trigalis/Legends |hu=Trigalis |it=Trigalis |pl=Trigalis |pt=Legends:Trigalis }} [[Category:Galactic Republic planets]] [[Category:Juris sector locations]] [[Category:Locations along the Five Veils Route]] [[Category:Planets in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Planets in the Trailing Sectors]] [[Category:Shadowports]] [[Category:Swamp planets]]
